source.runtime_policy: Reference files are provenance only; package/runtime never opens a backup or Isaac/USD path.
source.material_policy: Three original repository-generated laboratory JPG maps decoded to lossless PNG with identical decoded RGB pixels for MuJoCo. No remote Isaac/Omniverse or third-party photographic assets copied.
source.detail_modeling: Original deterministic chamfer meshes and primitives; visible handles, fasteners, rack modules, grilles, BNC sockets, instrument controls, keycaps, casters and maintenance tools. No external model downloads.
source.assembly_policy: Companion geometry profile removes RethinkMount including physical proxies and inertia. This visual payload alone is massless; geometry variant C is not covered by legacy scientific evidence.
source.finish_revision: Moderate neutral illumination with one indoor shadow-casting source; inward-facing cabinet; continuous tubular yellow/black rails with curved elbows, couplers and anchors; blank computer monitor.
source.storage_layout_revision: Added a massless low storage cabinet beside the control rack; sensor tray, coiled cable, reference weights and logbook are authored primitives. Trolley moved to the left of the computer bench by the rear wall.

safe_excitation_envelope.sampling_method: nominal plus six translation extrema, six rotation extrema, and eight translation corners; finite samples are not a continuous proof
safe_excitation_envelope.source: pre-registered conservative envelope around the Phase 06 safe Gamma=0.15 authoring range

lighting_reference.strategy: Neutral ambient plus key and non-shadow fill; MuJoCo indoor key is a spotlight below ceiling. One shadow map prevents contradictory cast directions. Values adapted by native-render inspection, not claimed equivalent across renderers.

instrument screens show fixed decorative graphics, not live scientific telemetry
